bullets: On Monday 2 November, Dubai recorded 822 sales worth AED 2.1bn, which is 10.2% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 58.9% of sales, compared to 56.3% over the last 7 days.
The median price was AED 1,721 per sqft, up 3.3% from the 30-day average and down 3.7% from last year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas were JVC with 239 sales, Liwan1 with 185, and Dubai South with 150.
In October new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Emaar has proposed a buyout of remaining Emaar Development shares, representing a major corporate restructuring by the emirate's largest developer.
October Dubai residential sales climbed to AED 25.15 billion, showing robust transaction growth and rising activity within the secondary property sector.
